title: Local Outlier Factor (LOF)
description: Density-based anomaly detection identifying points whose local density is significantly lower than their neighbors.
conditions: Feature space exhibits clusters with substantially different densities
Univariate and global distance metrics fail because normal density varies across regions
recommended_methods: Local Outlier Factor with k-nearest neighbors (typically k = 20)
Minkowski or Euclidean distance metric computation
Standardized feature matrix input via RobustScaler
selection_rules: If dataset contains multiple dense clusters alongside sparse clusters, select LOF over Isolation Forest
LOF score ~ 1.0 indicates similar density to neighbors (inlier); score > 1.5 indicates significant local outlier
If dataset has large sample size N > 50,000, avoid LOF due to O(N^2) neighbor query overhead
limitations: High computational cost on large datasets
Curse of dimensionality degrades neighbor distance discrimination in high dimensions (P > 30)
source: Breunig et al. (2000) LOF: Identifying Density-Based Local Outliers
